关闭开机自启动会删除 NetDriveGuard 自己创建的登录任务，不会删除程: Turning off startup removes the logon task created by NetDriveGuard. It does not delete program files or legacy tasks. Continue?
演示状态由内置脚本生成，不访问网络，也不会连接或断开网络驱动器。: Demo states are simulated. No network access or mapping changes are performed.
当前为只读原型，尚未配置监控目标，不会连接或断开网络驱动器。: No monitoring target is configured. No network drives will be connected or disconnected.
仅监控提醒：未启用离线取消或恢复重连。需要自动维护时，请在常用设置中选择。: Monitoring only. Automatic disconnection and reconnection are off. Enable them in General settings if needed.

自动维护已启用：确认离线后取消失效映射，服务器恢复可用后自动重连。盘符冲突时不操: Automatic maintenance enabled: disconnect after confirming offline, then reconnect when available. Conflicting drive mappings are left unchanged.
历史事件无法读取，本次运行仍会继续监控。: Cannot read event history. Monitoring will continue.
首次运行尚未配置，设置窗口即将打开；保存前不会访问网络或修改映射。: No configuration found. Settings will open. No network access or mapping changes occur until you save.
配置文件无法安全加载，请打开设置重新保存。未执行任何网络检查。: Cannot load the configuration. Open Settings and save it again. No network checks have been performed.
配置文件无法安全加载，网络检查未启动。: Cannot load the configuration. Network checks have not started.

配置保存失败，现有监控状态未改变。: Failed to save configuration. Existing monitoring is unchanged.

保存目录不能位于被监控的网络盘。请选择本机磁盘目录。: The data folder cannot be on the monitored drive. Choose a local disk.
文件保存失败，请检查目录权限和可用空间。仍使用旧目录；新目录可能留有部分复制文件: Failed to save files. Check folder permissions and free space. The old folder remains active; partial copies may remain in the new folder. No original files were deleted.

开机自启动设置更新失败，监控配置未应用。: Failed to update Windows startup settings. Monitoring configuration was not applied.
开机自启动设置更新失败，监控配置未应用。系统中已有的任务不会被覆盖或删除。: Failed to update Windows startup settings. Monitoring configuration was not applied. Existing system tasks will not be overwritten or deleted.
配置已应用，监控仍暂停；恢复监控后开始检查。: Configuration applied. Monitoring remains paused; resume it to start checking.
配置已应用，将按设置检查并执行自动操作。: Configuration applied. Checks and automatic actions will follow your settings.
配置已应用，将开始只读检查。: Configuration applied. Read-only checks will begin.
未配置监控目标，本次检查已跳过。: No monitoring target is configured. This check was skipped.
脱敏诊断已导出。报告不包含共享地址、用户名、密码、事件描述或本机路径。: Diagnostics exported. The report excludes share paths, usernames, passwords, event descriptions and local paths.
诊断导出失败，请选择其他可写目录后重试。: Diagnostic export failed. Choose another writable folder and try again.
事件文件无法写入，状态仍保留在本次运行内。: Cannot write the event log. Events remain available for this session.
无法读取程序数据，请检查保存目录及默认目录中的 storage-path.jso: Cannot read application data. Check the data folder and storage-path.json in the default folder. Startup has stopped to avoid using the wrong configuration.
语言修改将在下次启动时生效，历史日志保留原文。: Language changes take effect after restarting. Existing log entries keep their original text.

目标盘符存在映射冲突。: The target drive letter has a conflicting mapping.
监控过程中发生内部错误。: An internal error occurred during monitoring.
盘符必须使用类似 Z: 的格式。: Use a drive letter such as Z:.
共享地址必须包含服务器和共享名称。: The share path must include a server and share name.
离线确认次数必须位于 2 到 10 之间。: The offline confirmation count must be between 2 and 10.
TCP 超时必须位于 100 毫秒到 10 秒之间。: The TCP timeout must be between 100 milliseconds and 10 seconds.
总检查超时必须大于 TCP 超时且不超过 2 分钟。: The overall timeout must exceed the TCP timeout and must not exceed 2 minutes.
自定义模式必须提供检测周期。: Specify a check interval for custom mode.
自定义周期必须位于 1 秒到 30 分钟之间。: The custom interval must be between 1 second and 30 minutes.
